entries.heading: AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS
ancestors: TITLE VIII—UNITED STATES COMMISSION ON INTERNATIONAL RELIGIOUS FREEDOM REAUTHORIZATION
entries.text:
SEC. 808. AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS.

    Section 207(a) of the International Religious Freedom Act of 1998 
(22 U.S.C. 6435(a)) is amended by striking ``2016 to 2019'' and 
inserting ``2019 through 2022''.
